hypothesis: A learned low-level action policy can generalize to new tape lengths and unseen high-level program compositions when task-neutral interfaces expose local observations and previous predicted actions. Test whether source connectome helps beyond matched controls.
metrics: full output and completed program and learned halt
invalid actions and resource budget failures
teacher-action agreement on local training observations
data_source: Procedural Python teacher trajectories; no language-model distillation.
given: High-level program, primitive-action semantics, tape/output memory, supervised teacher actions in training. High-level plan choice is not learned.
selection: Train and short validation only; freeze code and budget before opening final results.
split: Unseen pairs of operations, lengths 16/64/256, program depths 4/8/16. Every regular set has 75 percent nonempty outputs.
